title: Landscaping in Parrita, Costa Rica | MA Soluciones
description: Landscaping and irrigation in Parrita and the Central Pacific: irrigation systems, automatic watering and garden maintenance for homes and hotels.
h1: Landscaping in Parrita and the Central Pacific
lead: We design and install irrigation systems and planned landscaping for residences, hotels and condos, with professional garden maintenance across the Central Pacific.
heroAlt: Planned landscaping and automatic irrigation project by MA Soluciones in the Central Pacific

faqs.q: What types of irrigation systems do you install?
faqs.a: We install drip, spray and sprinkler systems with automatic programmers, including rain sensors and water-saving technology — ideal for the dry season in the Central Pacific.

faqs.q: Do you maintain existing gardens and green areas?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide scheduled garden maintenance for residences, condos, hotels and institutions, including pruning, fertilizing and pest control, with service plans adapted to each property.

faqs.q: Can you design landscaping for a new construction project?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We plan landscaping from the design stage, coordinating with our construction team so planting, irrigation and outdoor lighting are installed together with your project.
